in_sanskrit.name: कास्तुरि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Friend or companion of the Kasturi plant. The Kasturi plant is a type of jasmine. This name is mentioned in the Mahabharata, specifically the Anushasana Parva, in a conversation between Bhishma and Vidura.
